scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic. It explicitly separates the exact density-band projection, the Mills-ratio asymptotic, the negligible lower-tail clip, and the testing reduction. Numerical verification is supplementary and is not used as proof.
scientific.limitations: The exact formula is a one-sample total-variation modulus for the null-side band used in the adaptive Gaussian missing-data lower bound. Product total variation is bounded by tensorization rather than evaluated exactly; the confidence-interval consequence is a lower bound and does not claim a matching upper constant. Fixed MCAR missingness and known scale are assumed in the asymptotic confidence statement.

title: Exact Gaussian missingness modulus and a log-log adaptation window
